sourceNormalization: Git text normalized to LF; archive members hashed as bytes.

registrySnapshot.selection: All 5.x stable releases plus the last listed stable release of each older major (3.5.31 and 4.4.11). Remaining catalog versions are inventoried but their archives and behavior are not verified; this is not a minimum support declaration.
registrySnapshot.scope: Live npm metadata plus downloaded archive hashes; registry signatures and publisher authorization were not independently verified.

observations.sourceAssociationScope: Registry gitHead manifests are source associations only. Missing gitHead or unavailable Git paths are retained as gaps; core version does not establish published availability or minimum support.
